semantic_delta.note: Repair wave 1dee2536 for finding-63fad9ec, finding-910c2159, finding-a5686f52 and finding-f055a9eb. (1) continuation accumulation: build_next_cursor now reports the contiguous union of the caller-proven range (known_complete_range or same-epoch cursor) and this read's coverage instead of only the current window, so a valid continuation advances monotonically, never replays the known bytes, and reaches the full-snapshot terminal range instead of ping-ponging between prefix and suffix windows; ambiguous unions fail closed with no cursor. (2) conflicting overlap: StreamingRecordDeduplicator proves identity against the still-retained window, so only byte-identical overlap is dropped; different content at an accepted position, or an overlap that can no longer be proven, becomes overlap_conflict, the batch drops to Partial with a diagnostic, and promotion is refused even when byte ranges look complete. (3) persistent-test boundary restored: the production-source unit test boundary_scan_honors_cancellation_after_io_has_started was removed and an in-flight deadline case was added to the admitted test asset through the public API. (4) test oracle: the three-entrypoints test no longer locks in the defective expectation (it now asserts accumulated coverage and no-reread on continuation), a conflicting-overlap negative control was added next to the exact-duplicate equality assertions, and a public-boundary deadline test was added. Frozen commands on the final tree: rollout_blockers 6 passed, conformance 31 passed, stage2_input 3 passed, git diff --check exit 0. Promotion to ForwardAppend still requires the single-read full-snapshot formal proof; accumulated cross-request coverage itself is not claimed as promotion evidence.
